data.gender_notes: Tilok is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Tilok is recorded with the meaning “Mark of God”. Tilok is a Hindu name meaning “Mark of God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
